description: This file contains unit tests for filesystem-related classes such as File and Directory, utilizing the Google Test framework. The tests cover file creation, opening, reading, writing, attribute checks, moving files, directory creation, iteration, and path manipulation.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class representing a filesystem file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, and attribute management.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: A class representing a filesystem directory with methods to create, iterate, and manipulate directory contents.
